title: Tempo Studio Screen Will Not Turn On
shortDescription: Tempo Studio display dark with cabinet plugged in.
fullDescription: Tempo Studio uses a 42-inch HD display powered by an internal AC supply. Loose IEC power cord or tripped surge protector are the most common causes.

fixSteps.title: Reseat IEC cord
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and firmly reseat the cord at both ends.

fixSteps.title: Direct outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Bypass surge protector and plug into wall directly.

whenToCallPro: Tempo support if reseat doesn't work.

faq.a: Tempo wound down operations; existing units retain class library access on grandfathered subs.

title: Tempo 3D Sensor Cannot Track Reps
shortDescription: Reps not counted, form feedback missing.
fullDescription: Tempo's 3D depth camera requires the user to stand 6-8 ft back in adequate lighting. Out-of-frame, dim rooms, or sensor lens dust break tracking.

fixSteps.title: Stand back
fixSteps.instruction: Position 6-8 ft from screen, fully in frame.

fixSteps.title: Clean lens
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe top sensor lens with microfiber.

whenToCallPro: If sensor still fails after lens clean and reboot, may need depth camera replacement.
videoSearchQuery: Tempo AI form tracking not working

faq.q: Does AI work in dark room?
faq.a: Tempo recommends 200+ lux for reliable depth tracking.

title: Tempo Companion App Cannot Reach Studio
shortDescription: App says studio offline, but unit is on.
fullDescription: App-to-Studio communication is over the cloud. If the studio is on Wi-Fi but the app cannot see it, both must be on the same logged-in account.

fixSteps.title: Verify account
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm same email logged in on app and studio.

faq.q: Can the app work without the studio?
faq.a: Yes for Tempo Move workouts; Studio classes need the studio online.

title: Tempo Studio Weight Plates Not Recognized
shortDescription: AI Tags on plates not seen by camera.
fullDescription: Weight plates have AI Tags read by the camera. Plates installed backward, dim lighting, or scuffed tags break detection.

fixSteps.title: Re-orient plates
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure AI Tags face the screen camera.

fixSteps.title: Clean tags
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe tags with damp cloth; replace scuffed ones from Tempo store.

faq.a: Only Tempo plates have AI Tags; standard plates need manual entry.

title: Tempo Class Stutters During Stream
shortDescription: Live or on-demand class pauses to load.
fullDescription: Tempo recommends 15 Mbps for reliable HD streaming. Slower connections cause stutter during live classes.

fixSteps.title: Speed test
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm at least 15 Mbps near studio.

title: Tempo Studio Update Hangs at Percentage
fullDescription: Tempo updates can take 20-30 min. A frozen progress bar usually self-recovers; otherwise a power cycle and retry resolves it.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Allow up to 45 min before action.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Hard reboot and let update resume.

faq.a: Updates are mandatory to access classes.

title: Tempo Studio No Audio in Class
fullDescription: Bluetooth pairing or muted volume are the common culprits. Tempo also has parental quiet hours that can mute audio.

fixSteps.title: Forget Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Bluetooth > forget all paired devices.

title: Tempo Studio Display Tilted or Loose
fullDescription: Tempo Studio's mounting bolts can loosen with frequent door slamming or rolling. Re-tightening internal bolts restores alignment.

fixSteps.title: Open back panel
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear access panel and re-tighten frame bolts.

whenToCallPro: If frame is bent, request service replacement.

faq.q: Does Tempo Studio need wall anchoring?
faq.a: Yes — tip-resistant strap should be installed.

title: Tempo Studio Touchscreen Not Responding
fullDescription: A frozen touchscreen is usually a software hang. A force reboot fixes most cases.
whenToCallPro: If touch still dead, digitizer replacement is service-only.

faq.a: Tempo has a companion app for navigation.

title: Tempo Cannot Pair Heart Rate Strap
fullDescription: Tempo supports BLE HR straps. Low strap battery or interference are common pairing problems.

fixSteps.title: Wet contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Moisten strap and put it on before pairing.

faq.a: Most BLE Smart straps including Polar, Wahoo, Garmin HRM.
